name: Electric Food Chopper & Vegetable Cutter | Multifunctional USB Rechargeable Food Processor | Chopping, Slicing, Grating & Grinding
description:
Make everyday food preparation faster and easier with this Multifunctional Electric Food Chopper & Vegetable Cutter. Designed for convenient chopping, slicing, grating, and grinding, this compact kitchen processor helps simplify meal preparation for a variety of ingredients. Its durable ABS and stainless-steel construction provides a practical combination of strength and everyday usability. The built-in rechargeable battery and Type-C charging port allow convenient cordless operation, while the compact design makes it easy to store and use in the kitchen or during outdoor activities.

Key Features
Multifunctional electric food chopper and vegetable cutter
Suitable for chopping, slicing, grating, and grinding
Powerful motor for quick food preparation
Durable ABS body with stainless-steel cutting components
USB rechargeable design with Type-C charging port
Built-in 800mAh rechargeable lithium battery
Suitable for vegetables, fruits, herbs, chili, meat, and other food ingredients
Open feeding port for convenient ingredient addition
Compact and lightweight design for easy handling
One-button operation for simple everyday use
Removable components for convenient cleaning
Includes cleaning brush for easier maintenance
Suitable for home kitchens, camping, and outdoor cooking
Stylish green finish

Product Type: Electric Food Chopper & Vegetable Cutter

Material: ABS Plastic & Stainless Steel
Charging Port: Type-C USB

How to Use
Charge the chopper fully using the Type-C charging cable before first use
Prepare the food ingredients and cut larger pieces into suitable sizes if required
Add ingredients through the feeding opening
Secure the required attachment or cutting component
Press the power button to start processing
Process the ingredients until the desired consistency is achieved
Switch off the device before removing or cleaning the components
Add a small amount of detergent and use the cleaning function where applicable
Rinse the washable parts thoroughly with clean water

Material / Composition
Durable ABS Plastic Body
Stainless-Steel Cutting Components
Rechargeable Lithium Battery
Type-C Charging Port
Food Processing Chamber
Cleaning Brush

Safety Information
Keep hands and fingers away from cutting blades during operation
Do not operate the device without properly securing the components
Do not overload the food chamber
Keep the charging port and electrical components dry
Do not use damaged blades or attachments
Switch off the device before cleaning or changing attachments
Keep away from children
